davy-safety-lamp.description: A miner in dark work clothes crouches in a low tunnel with timber supports and rough stone walls. He holds up a lit lantern with a mesh cage around the flame, and his face looks weary and dirty. The painting is dark and painterly, with no visible text, frame or border.

swiss-army-knife-introduced.description: A folding multi-blade pocket knife with a wooden handle, brass bolster and a fanned-out blade, a bottle or can opener hook and a screwdriver tip, rests on a dark grey woven fabric with gold highlights against a black background. Painted in a dark, oil-like style with no visible text or frame.

electric-flashlight-ever-ready.description: A gloved hand holds a dark metal tube with brass rings and a glowing lens, its beam cutting across a wet cobbled street. Gas-style street lamps line a row of old brick buildings in the background, and the scene is dim and night-time with an oil-painting look.

kodak-brownie-camera.description: A boy with short brown hair in a dark sailor-collared top and shorts stands in dense green foliage, holding a black box camera with a top viewfinder hood up to his face and looking down into it. A shaggy, dark-and-tan terrier-type dog sits at the lower right, looking up at him. Painterly, dark oil-style brushwork; the painting fills the frame edge to edge. A tiny faint mark sits in the bottom right corner.

thermos-vacuum-flask.description: An open brass-collared metal flask wrapped in brown leather stands on a tartan blanket with its silver cup beside it, holding dark liquid with steam rising. A cork lies on the blanket at left and a wicker picnic hamper sits behind. Oil-painting style, dark background, edge to edge with no visible text, frame or border.

leica-i-camera.description: A man in a flat cap and dark overcoat raises a small black rangefinder camera with a chrome lens to his eye, in a dim, lamp-lit city street. Behind him are a vintage car with its headlamp on, pedestrians in hats and long coats, and shopfronts with glowing windows. The painting is an oil-style night scene that fills the frame edge to edge, with blurred shop signs that show no readable letters.

zippo-lighter-introduced.description: A cupped hand holds an open brass-toned metal lighter with its lid raised behind it. A tall orange flame rises from a perforated chimney, with sparks drifting up. Behind it, tall grass bends under a dark, stormy dusk sky. The painting is oil-like and fills the whole image edge to edge. No text or border is visible.

handie-talkie-radio.description: A helmeted soldier in an olive uniform and a camouflage-netted helmet crouches in dense foliage at night, holding a boxy hand-held radio up to his mouth with a long thin whip antenna extended upward. The background is dark smoke or woodland, with faint light on the left. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text, signature or border.

kodak-instamatic-camera.description: Oil-painting style scene of two hands handling a black and silver box camera with its top cover lifted off, a flat black rectangular module lying to the right, and a small blue cube (like a flashcube) on rough, straw-like ground against a dark background. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the whole image.

hp-35-pocket-calculator.description: A dim, oil-painting style still life. A black hand-held calculator with a red LED display and blue and tan keys sits in the centre of a dark wooden desk, lit by a warm lamp at upper left. Beside it lie a wooden slide rule, drafting dividers and a compass, a pencil, and crumpled paper next to sheets with diagrams. No people are visible, and no legible text or frame is apparent.

motorola-dynatac-8000x.description: A dark, oil-painted still life. In the foreground, a large beige-and-black brick-style mobile handset stands upright on a wooden table, with a long antenna rising from its top, a numeric keypad, and a small speaker grille. Behind it lies a brown leather suitcase with brass latches, and behind that a boxy CRT computer monitor and stacks of papers. The setting is an office or study, with no people visible. There are no letters or numbers legible on the image, and no visible frame or border around the painting.

blackberry-email-device.description: A black handheld device with a small grey-green screen above a dense QWERTY thumb keyboard, with a bronze-tinted metal edge, sits clipped at a dark leather belt or holster on a dark coat. The painting is dark and painterly with heavy brushwork, and the frame is filled edge to edge by the coat and device. No other people or setting are visible.

apple-ipad-introduced.description: A dark, oil-painted still life of an upholstered armchair. A black tablet with a thin silver bezel and a single round button at the bottom sits tilted on the arm. A black ceramic mug and a folded newspaper sit on the left arm, and a dark knitted blanket hangs over the right side. The screen is blank grey, and there are no people. The painting fills the whole square edge to edge.

airpods-wireless-earbuds.description: A painted close-up of an open white charging case with two white earbuds resting inside, on a grey and red patterned upholstered seat beside a metal armrest. The lighting is warm and dim, with a window glowing at the top right of a dark vehicle interior. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing graphic.

samsung-galaxy-fold.description: A dark, thickly brushed oil-style painting of a black folding phone lying half open on a round wooden table, with a coffee cup and saucer blurred in the top right. The two screens glow with blurred, unreadable app icons, and a warm light falls from the left across the table. The dark background looks like a room interior with a window at the top left.

apple-airtag-tracker.description: A dark, oil-painting style still life. Dark brown-black cushions or upholstery fill the frame in deep shadow. In the lower left, a bunch of brass house keys on a split ring has a round silver-and-white tag with an Apple logo attached. To the right, a smartphone with a dark case lies across the fabric, its screen showing a map with a small location pin. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.
